name: Internal Lateral Movement Campaign
description: After gaining an initial foothold, an attacker is performing systematic lateral movement through the internal network using valid credentials and WMI/SMB protocols. Multiple hosts are being compromised.
objective: Track the attacker's lateral movement path, identify all compromised hosts, and contain the spread before critical infrastructure is reached.

events.message: Internal port scan: 10.0.2.55 scanning TCP/445 (SMB) across subnet 10.0.1.0/24
SMB authentication successful: 10.0.2.55 -> file-server-01 (10.0.1.20) using credentials htaylor
WMI remote process creation: 10.0.2.55 executed cmd.exe on app-server-02 (10.0.1.35)
Connection attempt from app-server-02 to db-server-01 (10.0.1.50) on port 1433 (MSSQL)

hints: Internal scanning on port 445 often precedes SMB lateral movement
Track the IP addresses making connections to multiple internal hosts
WMI is commonly used for remote command execution without needing extra tools
Isolate each compromised host to stop the spread
